     case TaskArgs.validate("spec.validate", rest, invalid) do
       :ok -> :ok
       {:error, message} ->
         print_verdict("fail", tier: "usage", error_findings: 0)

5. test/mix/tasks/spec_tasks_test.exs:191-199 — flip the assertion at :198 to `assert List.last(messages) == "spec.validate result=fail tier=usage error_findings=0"` and add `@tag spec: ["specled.tasks.verdict_line"]` immediately above the `test "spec.validate rejects invalid CLI options"` line. 6. test/mix/tasks/spec_tasks_test.exs:940 — insert `@tag spec: ["specled.tasks.verdict_line"]` above `test "spec.validate rejects invalid min strength values"` (:941).
